positions.description: Leading QA and engineering automation for PAYG solar energy infrastructure serving communities across 7 African markets. Driving platform reliability, observability, and test automation strategy.
achievements: Architected and led migration of legacy manual QA workflows to a fully automated SDET pipeline using Playwright, Cypress, and custom Ruby harnesses — reducing regression cycle time by 60%
Designed and deployed observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, ELK) across 7 African market deployments, cutting mean-time-to-detection from hours to minutes
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines integrating automated security scanning, performance benchmarks, and contract testing across microservices
Drove cross-functional alignment between product, engineering, and data teams to establish quality gates and SLA-driven release criteria
Introduced chaos engineering practices and load testing frameworks (K6, Locust) to validate system resilience under peak PAYG billing cycles

Designed shared RabbitMQ-backed bounded contexts (Payment, Token, Subscription) as a reusable platform layer serving all product teams; decoupled synchronous PAYG processing, eliminated peak-load timeouts, unblocked release cadence from 2 to 12+ deploys per week — a paved-roads / golden-paths platform pattern adopted across the engineering org

Delivered 900+ end-to-end automated scenarios across payments, IoT provisioning, token lifecycle, and subscription flows; reduced regression from 3 days to 45 minutes; enabled continuous deployment across 7 markets
Line-managed 4 engineers across Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania — 2 promoted to senior within tenure; enforced architectural standards and OWASP Top 10 secure coding through structured code reviews

positions.role: Director of Engineering / Sole Technical Founder
positions.description: Founded and built an ML-driven security platform for Software-in-a-Medical-Device (SiMD) and Software-as-a-Medical-Device (SaMD) applications, targeting HIPAA-compliant vulnerability detection and compliance automation for healthcare providers.
achievements: Designed and built a FastAPI orchestration layer with CQRS and event-sourced domain model, routing scanning jobs through async task queues with saga-based compensation for partial failures
Implemented high-performance Rust+PyO3 modules for binary analysis and SBOM generation, achieving 50-100x throughput improvement over pure Python equivalents
Built ML pipelines combining CNNs for medical image metadata analysis, RAG for compliance document retrieval, and GNNs for dependency-graph vulnerability propagation
Developed compliance automation tooling mapping scan results to HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and IEC 62304 requirements with automated evidence generation
Delivered full MLOps stack: Airflow orchestration, MLflow experiment tracking, SageMaker/Vertex AI training, and A/B model deployment with canary rollouts

Implemented Circuit Breaker + exponential backoff in Go to absorb burst load on GPU evaluation workers — custom half-open state machine equivalent of Resilience4j (5s initial interval, 2× multiplier, 60s ceiling) with async Kafka drain on open-circuit; zero customer-facing timeouts during a live degradation event, circuit self-healed without manual intervention

Productionised AI-assisted development tooling — integrated LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) for automated compliance documentation generation, reducing manual report assembly to zero; foundation for AI-assisted DevOps tooling experimentation
Shipped idempotent SQS / SNS / Kinesis + Kafka pipelines with DLQs and exactly-once semantics; full CloudWatch + X-Ray observability and customer-facing SLAs

positions.description: Led engineering for a government-scale digital addressing and logistics platform, enabling formal address assignment for previously unaddressed urban areas in Nairobi, Kenya.
achievements: Led a 5-engineer team delivering a digital address platform that assigned formal addresses to 2.3 million Nairobi residents, integrating with Kenya's national addressing initiative
Architected computer-vision and GIS pipeline using Google Cloud Vision for address-plate recognition, PostGIS for spatial queries, and Google Cloud Pub/Sub for event-driven geocoding workflows
Built full-stack delivery: React/Next.js dashboard for administrators, Express API gateway, MongoDB document store, and GCP Cloud Run deployment with auto-scaling
Applied advanced geospatial algorithms (Dijkstra's, A*) for last-mile route optimization, reducing delivery time by 35% in pilot zones

Initial production deployment was on Azure (App Service, Azure SQL Database, Azure Blob Storage, Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, with Azure Virtual Machines for runtime management during the on-premises-equivalent phase) before evolving to a hybrid Azure + GCP Cloud Run model — a direct precedent for predominantly on-prem Windows Server environments evolving toward hybrid cloud

Designed a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) platform layer in Go that separated field-agent mobile from county-government web surfaces; defined OpenAPI specs, RESTful APIs, and Kafka event pipelines as shared platform standards adopted by Nairobi County Government as official infrastructure

positions.description: Modernized legacy actuarial and billing systems into microservices architecture, supporting reinsurance treaty management, premium calculation, and claims processing workflows.

Identified and resolved critical performance bottlenecks in batch premium calculation pipelines, achieving 4x throughput improvement through query optimization and caching strategies
Established service boundary contracts using OpenAPI specs and Pact contract testing, enabling independent deployment across 6 engineering teams

positions.description: Contributed to petabyte-scale video streaming and telecommunications network management infrastructure, working on low-level systems for content delivery and OSS/BSS workflows.

Built reactive stream processing pipelines for real-time network telemetry, enabling sub-second anomaly detection across distributed CDN nodes
Designed fault-tolerant architecture patterns for content delivery, implementing circuit breakers and retry mechanisms that maintained 99.95% uptime during peak traffic

positions.description: Built security scanning platform features, contributing to the decomposition of a J2EE monolith into microservices while developing CI/CD integrations for enterprise DevSecOps workflows.
achievements: Designed and implemented HATEOAS-compliant REST APIs using Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, and C#/.NET, supporting multi-tenant scan orchestration with role-based access control
Built CI/CD DevSecOps integrations (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) enabling customers to embed security scanning directly into their build pipelines
Contributed to OWASP Top 10 and NIST SSDF compliance features, implementing automated policy engines that mapped scan findings to regulatory requirements

Owned the Veracode Visual Studio plugin (.NET 4.5 / Windows platform component) end-to-end — enabling developers to run SAST analysis at file, project, solution, or pipeline granularity directly inside Visual Studio, or to inject the .NET backend into enterprise CI/CD systems for shift-left secure coding. The entire platform stack ran on-premises on Windows Server (2012/2016 era), the most direct precedent in this resume to predominantly-on-prem Windows Server platforms

Led the platform upgrade to enforce TLS 1.2 across the .NET 4.5 plugin and on-premises Windows Server backend services — a compliance-critical delivery for enterprise customers in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, government), requiring coordinated changes across the plugin, client-facing APIs, and on-prem server configuration

Owned the full SDLC and continuous-delivery pipeline for plugin releases — produced MSIX packaging and signed delivery artefacts, managed versioning and backward compatibility for clients on mixed .NET Framework versions, and rollout sequencing across a large installed base of Fortune 500 customers running on-prem Windows Server
